Viego_Original_MoveFirst_0.title: The Queen's Call
Viego_Original_MoveFirst_0.description: A dark and obsessive declaration of love and devotion to a mysterious woman, hinting at a willingness to commit great acts for her sake.

Viego_Original_MoveFirst_1.title: Unrelenting Pursuit
Viego_Original_MoveFirst_1.description: A resolute statement of determination and ruthlessness, suggesting that no obstacle will hinder the speaker's quest for their desired goal, likely related to the woman mentioned in the first voice line.

Viego_Original_MoveFirst_2.title: A Doomed World
Viego_Original_MoveFirst_2.description: A chilling prophecy of destruction and suffering, implying that the speaker's pursuit of their goal will lead to a bleak and inevitable outcome for all involved.

Viego_Original_Move_0.title: Endless Agony
Viego_Original_Move_0.description: Viego’s eternal pain echoes through his voice, a constant reminder of the unbearable sorrow that consumes him from within.

Viego_Original_Move_1.title: The Price of Desire
Viego_Original_Move_1.description: A lament for the simple desires that are forever out of reach, forcing Viego to commit unspeakable acts in pursuit of what he cannot have.

Viego_Original_Move_2.title: The Endless Night
Viego_Original_Move_2.description: Viego clings to the hope of an end to his suffering, knowing that the darkness still has a firm grip on his soul.

Viego_Original_Move_3.title: Relentless Pursuit
Viego_Original_Move_3.description: With cold determination, Viego sends his minions to the farthest corners of the world, leaving no stone unturned in his search for his lost love.

Viego_Original_Move_4.title: Faded Glory
Viego_Original_Move_4.description: A melancholic reflection on a time when Viego and his love were untouched by darkness, their beauty unmarred by tragedy.

Viego_Original_Move_5.title: Memory of a Smile
Viego_Original_Move_5.description: Viego's mind is haunted by the delicate features of his beloved, a bittersweet memory that both comforts and torments him.

Viego_Original_Move_6.title: Lost Light
Viego_Original_Move_6.description: In the absence of Isolde, Viego is left stumbling in the darkness, his guiding star extinguished, leaving him in a void of despair.

Viego_Original_Move_7.title: Shadow of a King
Viego_Original_Move_7.description: Viego contemplates the hollow existence of a wraith, seeing himself as a mere shadow of the man he once was, consumed by an insatiable hunger.

Viego_Original_Move_8.title: Unyielding Wrath
Viego_Original_Move_8.description: Viego’s fury is merciless, directed at those who dare to defy him, labeling him a villain only to face certain death.

Viego_Original_Move_9.title: Phantom Plea
Viego_Original_Move_9.description: Viego is tormented by the imagined cries of his beloved, hearing her desperate calls for salvation that he is powerless to answer.

Viego_Original_Move_10.title: Consuming Obsession
Viego_Original_Move_10.description: Viego's obsession drives him to consume all in his path, leaving a trail of destruction in his wake, all in the name of reuniting with his lost love.

Viego_Original_Move_11.title: Rising Darkness
Viego_Original_Move_11.description: Viego’s ambitions extend far beyond the cursed Shadow Isles, foreshadowing a greater calamity that threatens to engulf the world.

Viego_Original_Move_12.title: Veil of Sorrow
Viego_Original_Move_12.description: The black mist that surrounds Viego is a manifestation of his eternal grief, a physical embodiment of the sorrow that never leaves him.

Viego_Original_Move_13.title: Innocence Reflected
Viego_Original_Move_13.description: Viego recalls the purity and kindness in Isolde's eyes, eyes that once saw a world unmarred by the cruelty he would unleash.

Viego_Original_Move_14.title: Endless Grasp
Viego_Original_Move_14.description: Viego refuses to let go of what he has lost, clinging to memories and ghosts as if they could somehow be reclaimed.

Viego_Original_Move_15.title: The Cure of Love
Viego_Original_Move_15.description: Viego believes that the key to dispelling the cursed mist lies in reuniting with Isolde, his love the only cure for the affliction that plagues him.

Viego_Original_Move_16.title: Sin of the Heart
Viego_Original_Move_16.description: Viego reflects on the tragic irony that the love he cherished above all else was the very thing that led to his downfall and the world’s suffering.

Viego_Original_Move_17.title: Fragile Affection
Viego_Original_Move_17.description: Viego muses on the delicate nature of love, a small spark that once kindled great joy but now lies shattered, unable to withstand the weight of his despair.

Viego_Original_Move_18.title: Embodiment of Darkness
Viego_Original_Move_18.description: Viego has fully embraced the darkness within, recognizing that he has become the very thing from which there is no escape.

Viego_Original_Move_19.title: The King’s Curse
Viego_Original_Move_19.description: Viego grapples with the cruel twist of fate that took Isolde from him, leaving him to wander the world alone, a cursed existence without her.

Viego_Original_Move_20.title: Monstrous Resolve
Viego_Original_Move_20.description: Viego acknowledges his transformation into a monster, resigned to the horrors he must commit to achieve his twisted goals.

Viego_Original_Move_21.title: Wrath of the Ruined King
Viego_Original_Move_21.description: In a final declaration of vengeance, Viego condemns the world that denied him his happiness, vowing to bring death and destruction to all who stand in his way.

Viego_Original_MoveLong_0.title: Birth of the Ruined King
Viego_Original_MoveLong_0.description: Isolde was my life. Viego died when she did and the ruined king was born.

Viego_Original_MoveLong_1.title: Tidal Surge
Viego_Original_MoveLong_1.description: The black mist flows from me like a tide. At times, it ebbs, but now we surge forward.

Viego_Original_MoveLong_2.title: Drowning Memory
Viego_Original_MoveLong_2.description: I remember her sinking beneath the waters... and then... and then...

Viego_Original_MoveLong_3.title: Destructive Beauty
Viego_Original_MoveLong_3.description: A world that would rob me of beauty is a world that deserves destruction.

Viego_Original_MoveLong_4.title: Relentless Vengeance
Viego_Original_MoveLong_4.description: Hate me if you must. Until she returns to my arms, all will be brought to ruin.

Viego_Original_MoveLong_5.title: Unstoppable Resolve
Viego_Original_MoveLong_5.description: I will rip her from the jaws of death. Fate cannot stop me. Nothing can.

Viego_Original_MoveLong_6.title: Crown of the Unlife
Viego_Original_MoveLong_6.description: A crown lost long ago, reborn in unlife, ripped away from his only love.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterFiddlestick.title: Eternal Slumber
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterFiddlestick.description: Ur-demon. When all life ends, you will return to your slumber.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterHecarim.title: Ambition's End
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterHecarim.description: For all your ambition, Hecarim, this is what you are reduced to.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterIllaoi.title: Defiant Sea Priestess
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterIllaoi.description: Your god could not stop me before, sea priestess. Do not challenge me again.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterKalista.title: Unfulfilled Vengeance
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterKalista.description: You will never have your vengeance, Kalista. Never.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterKarthus.title: Dirge of Loss
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterKarthus.description: Sing, Karthus. Sing of all that must be lost and she who must be found.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterKindred.title: Judgment Call
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterKindred.description: Answer for your crimes, death. Answer me.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterMaokai.title: Cursed Tree
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterMaokai.description: Go on then, tree. Defeat me if you can. It will never restore the isles.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterSenna.title: Hidden Face
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterSenna.description: Why, Isolde? Why do you hide your face from me?

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterThresh.title: Deceitful Chains
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterThresh.description: Your treachery does not surprise me, Thresh. Only that you believed you'd win.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterVladimir.title: Unseen Fury
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterVladimir.description: Hello, uncle. I'm surprised you haven't been torn apart by an angry mob.

Viego_Original_FirstEncounterYorick.title: Monk and Lost Love
Viego_Original_FirstEncounterYorick.description: Ah, the monk from the waters. And... someone else. Isolde?

Viego_Original_Taunt_0.title: Mournful Mockery
Viego_Original_Taunt_0.description: Viego taunts his enemies with a reminder of his own tragic loss, reveling in their suffering as a reflection of his own.

Viego_Original_Taunt_1.title: Haunting Presence
Viego_Original_Taunt_1.description: Viego’s taunt evokes the haunting specter of his past, reminding his foes of the darkness that envelops him.

Viego_Original_TauntResponse.title: Cruel Retort
Viego_Original_TauntResponse.description: A chilling response from Viego to those who dare mock him, underscoring his relentless pursuit of vengeance and sorrow.

Viego_Original_Joke_0.title: Wrong Pipe
Viego_Original_Joke_0.description: Viego humorously comments on the black mist entering his lungs, as if it were a mere mistake.

Viego_Original_Joke_1.title: Mist Command
Viego_Original_Joke_1.description: A frustrated Viego demands that the black mist leave his lungs, blending annoyance with his dark demeanor.

Viego_Original_JokeResponse.title: Ancient Humor
Viego_Original_JokeResponse.description: Viego reflects on the decline of humor over the centuries, hinting that it was once more refined in his time.

Viego_Original_Laugh.title: Haunting Laughter
Viego_Original_Laugh.description: Viego's laughter echoes with a chilling, unsettling tone, reflecting his dark and sorrowful nature.

Viego_Original_SFX_Dance_Music.title: Eerie Dance Melody
Viego_Original_SFX_Dance_Music.description: Music plays as Viego dances, with an eerie and haunting melody that reflects his dark, melancholic nature.

Viego_Original_BasicAttack_0.title: Grunt of Anger
Viego_Original_BasicAttack_0.description: Viego grunts with a fierce, angered tone as he strikes his foes.

Viego_Original_BasicAttack_1.title: Determined Growl
Viego_Original_BasicAttack_1.description: A deep, determined grunt escapes Viego as he continues his relentless assault.

Viego_Original_BasicAttack_2.title: Frustrated Snarl
Viego_Original_BasicAttack_2.description: Viego's grunt reveals a hint of frustration as he delivers another blow.

Viego_Original_BasicAttack_3.title: Fury-Filled Exertion
Viego_Original_BasicAttack_3.description: A powerful grunt accompanies Viego's attack, filled with his dark, unyielding fury.

Viego_Original_Attack_0.title: Fall Beneath My Blade
Viego_Original_Attack_0.description: Viego demands his enemies to fall before him, emphasizing his dominance with each strike.

Viego_Original_Attack_1.title: Deny Me No Longer
Viego_Original_Attack_1.description: Viego insists that no one should resist him, showcasing his relentless pursuit.

Viego_Original_Attack_2.title: Serve Me in Death
Viego_Original_Attack_2.description: A dark command from Viego, calling for submission even in death.

Viego_Original_Attack_3.title: My Love! My Love!
Viego_Original_Attack_3.description: Viego’s cry reveals his deep longing and obsession with his lost love as he attacks.

Viego_Original_Attack_4.title: Where Is She?!
Viego_Original_Attack_4.description: Viego’s anguished demand for the whereabouts of his beloved, driving his fury.

Viego_Original_Attack_5.title: You Stole Her from Me!
Viego_Original_Attack_5.description: Viego accuses his enemies of taking away his love, fueling his rage.

Viego_Original_Attack_6.title: Die for Her!
Viego_Original_Attack_6.description: A vicious command from Viego, demanding death as retribution for his lost love.

Viego_Original_Attack_7.title: Anything for Her
Viego_Original_Attack_7.description: Viego’s resolve to do anything for his love, underscoring his desperation and anger.

Viego_Original_Attack_8.title: Lowborn Filth
Viego_Original_Attack_8.description: Viego degrades his foes, showing his disdain and contempt as he strikes.

Viego_Original_Attack_9.title: The Mist Devours All
Viego_Original_Attack_9.description: A chilling statement from Viego, invoking the all-consuming mist as he attacks.

Viego_Original_Attack_10.title: Why Do You Fight?!
Viego_Original_Attack_10.description: Viego questions his enemies’ resistance, reflecting his frustration and dominance.

Viego_Original_Attack_11.title: I Am Inevitable
Viego_Original_Attack_11.description: Viego asserts his inescapable fate, reinforcing his relentless pursuit of vengeance.

Viego_Original_Attack_12.title: Ruin to All!
Viego_Original_Attack_12.description: Viego vows destruction for everyone, emphasizing his destructive nature.

Viego_Original_Attack_13.title: All Shall Know My Pain
Viego_Original_Attack_13.description: Viego declares his intent to make all aware of his suffering and grief.

Viego_Original_Attack_14.title: Stand Aside, Churl!
Viego_Original_Attack_14.description: A commanding call for his foes to yield, revealing his contempt for their defiance.

Viego_Original_Attack_15.title: This Is My Decree!
Viego_Original_Attack_15.description: Viego enforces his will with authority, showcasing his royal and tyrannical nature.

Viego_Original_Attack_16.title: The Mist Beckons!
Viego_Original_Attack_16.description: Viego invokes the mist as an all-encompassing force, drawing his enemies into its embrace.

Viego_Original_Attack_17.title: I Will Break Your Heart
Viego_Original_Attack_17.description: A menacing promise from Viego to shatter his enemies, reflecting his own broken heart.

Viego_Original_Attack_18.title: You Face the Ruined King
Viego_Original_Attack_18.description: Viego reminds his enemies of his powerful and cursed status as he engages them.

Viego_Original_Attack_19.title: Be One with the Mist
Viego_Original_Attack_19.description: Viego commands his foes to join the mist, highlighting its inescapable and consuming nature.

Viego_Original_Attack_20.title: I Must Have Her Back!
Viego_Original_Attack_20.description: Viego’s desperate plea for the return of his love fuels his relentless aggression.

Viego_Original_Attack_21.title: Peasant!
Viego_Original_Attack_21.description: A disdainful insult from Viego, reflecting his view of his enemies as beneath him.

Viego_Original_Attack_22.title: Bring Her Back!
Viego_Original_Attack_22.description: Viego demands the return of his lost love with a forceful and desperate tone.

Viego_Original_Attack_23.title: Return Her to Me!
Viego_Original_Attack_23.description: A commanding cry from Viego, insisting on the restoration of his beloved.

Viego_Original_Attack_24.title: You Dare Face a King?!
Viego_Original_Attack_24.description: Viego challenges his enemies with his regal authority, questioning their audacity.

Viego_Original_Attack_25.title: Love Is My Weapon!
Viego_Original_Attack_25.description: Viego declares his love as a potent force, intertwining his grief with his combat.

Viego_Original_Attack_26.title: She Would Want This!
Viego_Original_Attack_26.description: Viego justifies his actions by claiming that his love would have desired his vengeance.

Viego_Original_Attack_27.title: You Would Stop Me?
Viego_Original_Attack_27.description: Viego questions his enemies' attempts to hinder him, revealing his relentless resolve.

Viego_Original_Attack_28.title: Tell Me Where She Is!
Viego_Original_Attack_28.description: A desperate demand from Viego for information about his lost love.

Viego_Original_Attack_29.title: Be Brought to Ruin
Viego_Original_Attack_29.description: Viego condemns his foes to ruin, emphasizing his destructive intent.

Viego_Original_Q_0.title: Grunt of Power
Viego_Original_Q_0.description: Viego grunts, demonstrating the power and effort behind his strike with the Blade of the Ruined King.

Viego_Original_Q_1.title: Grunt of Resolve
Viego_Original_Q_1.description: A determined grunt from Viego, reflecting his resolve as he wields the Blade of the Ruined King.

Viego_Original_Q_2.title: Grunt of Vengeance
Viego_Original_Q_2.description: Viego's grunt reveals his drive for vengeance as he uses the Blade of the Ruined King.

Viego_Original_W_0.title: Laugh of the Damned
Viego_Original_W_0.description: Viego laughs with a haunting intensity as he unleashes Spectral Maw.

Viego_Original_W_1.title: Echoes of Laughter
Viego_Original_W_1.description: Viego's laughter echoes menacingly, signifying his dark enjoyment of Spectral Maw's power.

Viego_Original_W_2.title: Creeping Haunt
Viego_Original_W_2.description: Viego laughs in a chilling manner, reflecting the eerie presence of Spectral Maw.

Viego_Original_E_0.title: Heart's Command
Viego_Original_E_0.description: Viego declares his heart's command as he channels Harrowed Path.

Viego_Original_E_1.title: Path Granted
Viego_Original_E_1.description: Viego demands passage as he unleashes the mist of Harrowed Path.

Viego_Original_E_2.title: Mist Flow
Viego_Original_E_2.description: Viego calls for the mist to flow from him, guiding the Harrowed Path.

Viego_Original_E_3.title: Spill Forth
Viego_Original_E_3.description: Viego commands the mist to spill forth, spreading his influence.

Viego_Original_E_4.title: Search for Her
Viego_Original_E_4.description: Viego urges the mist to find her, reflecting his obsession.

Viego_Original_E_5.title: Forward, Mist
Viego_Original_E_5.description: Viego directs the mist to move forward, pushing it to consume all.

Viego_Original_E_6.title: All-Consuming
Viego_Original_E_6.description: Viego orders the mist to consume everything in its path.

Viego_Original_E_7.title: Grunt of Command
Viego_Original_E_7.description: Viego grunts as he exerts his will through Harrowed Path.

Viego_Original_E_8.title: Resounding Grunt
Viego_Original_E_8.description: A resounding grunt accompanies the power of Harrowed Path.

Viego_Original_E_9.title: Forceful Grunt
Viego_Original_E_9.description: Viego grunts forcefully, indicating the exertion of Harrowed Path's power.

Viego_Original_R_0.title: Claiming What's Mine
Viego_Original_R_0.description: Viego declares his intent to take what is rightfully his with Heartbreaker.

Viego_Original_R_1.title: Demanding Surrender
Viego_Original_R_1.description: Viego demands surrender as he unleashes Heartbreaker.

Viego_Original_R_2.title: Desperate Call
Viego_Original_R_2.description: Viego's desperate call for Isolde as he uses Heartbreaker.

Viego_Original_R_3.title: Calling for Isolde
Viego_Original_R_3.description: Viego calls out for Isolde in anguish while using Heartbreaker.

Viego_Original_R_4.title: Grunt of Resolve
Viego_Original_R_4.description: Viego grunts in determination as he activates Heartbreaker.

Viego_Original_R_5.title: Intense Grunt
Viego_Original_R_5.description: An intense grunt from Viego as he channels Heartbreaker’s power.

Viego_Original_Kill_0.title: Endless Suffering
Viego_Original_Kill_0.description: Viego reflects on the insignificance of his victim's pain compared to his own.

Viego_Original_Kill_1.title: Restless Dead
Viego_Original_Kill_1.description: Viego laments that the dead will not find peace until he is whole again.

Viego_Original_Kill_2.title: Subjects of My Wrath
Viego_Original_Kill_2.description: Viego declares that all living things are his subjects in his quest for vengeance.

Viego_Original_Kill_3.title: Cruel Love
Viego_Original_Kill_3.description: Viego acknowledges the cruelty of love, but remains confident that it will prevail.

Viego_Original_Kill_4.title: Trivial Sacrifice
Viego_Original_Kill_4.description: Viego dismisses his victim as insignificant in the face of his larger goal of reuniting with his love.

Viego_Original_Kill_5.title: Moment's Weight
Viego_Original_Kill_5.description: Viego emphasizes that the weight of his current moment far surpasses the significance of his victim.

Viego_Original_Kill_6.title: Flesh Will Do
Viego_Original_Kill_6.description: Viego is indifferent to the death of his victim, seeing their flesh as a mere means to an end.

Viego_Original_Kill_7.title: Insignificant Hero
Viego_Original_Kill_7.description: Viego belittles his victim, stating they are not the hero of any story and hold no value.

Viego_Original_Kill_8.title: Take Me to Her
Viego_Original_Kill_8.description: Viego demands that his victim guide him to his beloved, showing his relentless pursuit.

Viego_Original_KillHecarim.title: Eternal Servitude
Viego_Original_KillHecarim.description: In death as in life, Hecarim. You will fight only for me.

Viego_Original_KillKalista.title: Unbeliever's Fate
Viego_Original_KillKalista.description: You never believed in my rule, Kalista, and now, this is your fate.

Viego_Original_KillKindred.title: Conqueror of Death
Viego_Original_KillKindred.description: Arise, death, and greet the king who conquered you back!

Viego_Original_KillSenna.title: Unseen Reflections
Viego_Original_KillSenna.description: Isolde... I could not see myself in your eyes.

Viego_Original_KillThresh.title: Defiant Jailer
Viego_Original_KillThresh.description: You are simply the latest to defy me, jailer.

Viego_Original_KillVladimir.title: Angry Kin
Viego_Original_KillVladimir.description: So angry, uncle. It was one unanswered letter a thousand years ago.

Viego_Original_KillYorick.title: Desperate Plea
Viego_Original_KillYorick.description: Isolde! I know it is you! Show yourself to me!

Viego_Original_KillFirst_2.title: Unstoppable Force
Viego_Original_KillFirst_2.description: No power in this world can stop me!

Viego_Original_KillFirst_7.title: Forward Command
Viego_Original_KillFirst_7.description: Now, do as I say! Forward!

Viego_Original_KillFirst_8.title: Desire for the Body
Viego_Original_KillFirst_8.description: This body, is this what you desire?!

Viego_Original_KillPenta.title: Pentakill Carnage
Viego_Original_KillPenta.description: All this carnage. Do you see?! I do it for you!

Viego_Original_Recall_0.title: Reign Restored
Viego_Original_Recall_0.description: She will reign again at my side, and I shall be ruined no more.

Viego_Original_Recall_1.title: Inevitable Victory
Viego_Original_Recall_1.description: The mist will consume all. My victory is simply a matter of time.

Viego_Original_Recall_2.title: Awaiting Return
Viego_Original_Recall_2.description: I cast myself upon this broken throne awaiting her return.

Viego_Original_Respawn_0.title: Endless Ruination
Viego_Original_Respawn_0.description: The ruination cannot end. Not yet.

Viego_Original_Respawn_1.title: Unwavering Search
Viego_Original_Respawn_1.description: No. She remains in this world. I can feel it.

Viego_Original_Respawn_2.title: Death's Meaning
Viego_Original_Respawn_2.description: In a world without love, death means nothing.

Viego_Original_MoveTransformed_0.title: Form Is Nothing
Viego_Original_MoveTransformed_0.description: This form is nothing to me!

Viego_Original_MoveTransformed_1.title: Puppet Command
Viego_Original_MoveTransformed_1.description: Fight, puppet! Fight for your king!
